text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This paper presents the CRAFTY-Sweden agent-based land-use model applied at national scale across Sweden, explicitly modeling future land-use change and ecosystem service provision in the forestry sector under multiple future socio-economic and climate scenarios from 2010 to 2100.
